description: Kommunale Wärmeplanung Übersicht is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rips-gdi.lubw.baden-wuerttemberg.de. The current status of municipal heating planning in Baden-Württemberg can be seen in the map. The obligated city districts and large district cities are to be seen. In addition, it is shown which municipalities have already voluntarily entered into municipal heat planning. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal heating planning Overview" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include oac: 725. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
